nodes.label: Qeducato brand logo
nodes.rationale: Primary wordmark 'QEDUCATO' with a graduation-cap 'Q' monogram; navy-blue 'QEDU' plus coral/orange 'CATO'. Establishes the template's two-color brand palette (dark navy + coral) and its graduation-cap visual motif.

nodes.label: Qeducato education template (reference design)
nodes.rationale: The Referensi/qeducato folder holds assets of the 'Qeducato' education WordPress-style template used as visual/design reference for the akademik.unjani.ac.id project: brand logo, SVE line-art icon set, and hero slider imagery.

nodes.label: Qeducato brand identity: navy + coral, graduation-cap motif
nodes.rationale: Design decision: the logo pairs dark navy and coral/orange within one wordmark, with a graduation cap forming the 'Q' — reinforcing the education theme and defining the template's palette for headers, buttons and icons.
